source: Actual observed ordinary-code 4B application responses approved after two independent manual readings with documented limits

endpoint_launch_confirmation.evidence: Parent stopped the old server, setup --download verified the exact installed 4B SHA-256, and launched these exact weights through scripts/run_demo.py --local-llm session9942, which passed model health before candidate execution
endpoint_launch_confirmation.api_identity_limit: The provider API exposes alias astana-local only; installation manifest, full weight checksum and parent-confirmed launch establish the recorded model provenance

reviewers.scope: Read all seven accepted why/action pairs and the coffee/socket abstention; checked diagnostics and all five raw request/response hashes. This is a review of these observed outputs, not a guarantee for every future generation.
notes: No prior nonsense about stroking hands; no promised sockets, playground equipment, current opening, numeric route claims or safety in the accepted prose.
MEGA 'walk along a path in the park' is a category-derived activity suggestion. The dataset does not establish a specific path or its surface; actual access and route remain unverified.
Family 'place for children' relates the requested interest to the park category. It is not evidence of children's infrastructure, age suitability or safety; the application retains explicit warnings.

reviewers.scope: Independently read the complete candidate live-explanations and all five raw responses; explicitly authorized reviewed promotion
notes: All seven why/action pairs are coherent and tied to categories/interests; no prior nonsense or duplicated Idea prefix.
Architecture suggestions relate monument/theatre categories to external architectural observation.
A path in MEGA is a typical proposed activity, not confirmed infrastructure; family suitability/safety is unproven; this approval is no guarantee for future answers.

manual_review.note: Two independent readers approved these specific observed outputs with the documented limits; automatic checks alone did not grant this approval.
